test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following programmes was initiated in 1979 with the objective of upgrading the traditional skills of rural youth belonging to families living below the poverty line, with family income below ₹3,500 per year?

options.text: Training to Rural Youth for Self Employment (TRYSEM)

solution:
The correct answer is **__Training to Rural Youth for Self Employment (TRYSEM)__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

**TRYSEM scheme**

__
 
• This scheme was started in 1979 with the objective to help unemployed rural youth between the age of 18 and 35 years to acquire skills for self-employment.
 
• Priority was given to SC/ST Youth and Women.
 
• It enables them to take up income-generating activities (self/wage employment).
 
• The scheme had been merged into Swarnajayanti Gram Swarojgar Yojana (SGSY) in 1999.
 
• TRYSEM was implemented in each of the 5000 blocks across the nation as part of the IRDP's "self-employment for youth" component.

**Rural Youth:**

 
• ​In order to prepare youth to work for themselves, **each block was to choose forty young people 40 men and 40 women and train them in entrepreneurship and skill development**.
 
• It had been stipulated that at least** 50% of rural youth should be trained in SC/ST communities**.
 
• At** least half of the overall beneficiaries should be women**.
 
• The amount of rural youth moving to urban regions may be reduced because it was producing activities in the rural areas.
 
• Rural development would also benefit from the ability to meet local needs using nearby resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**National Rural Employment Programme (NREP)**

 
• The Rural Employment Program named Employment Guarantee Scheme was first introduced in Maharashtra in 1972-73.
 
• The Scheme was the first of its kind to give recognition to the 'Right to work" enshrined in the constitution.
 
• It emboided a commitment by the state to provide work to a person who comes forward to after labor.
 
• The NREP was launched in 1980 with a view to significantly increase employment opportunities in rural areas.

**Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)**

 
• Under the Wage Employment Programmes, the National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) and Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) were started in Sixth and Seventh Plans.
 
• The NREP and RLEGP were merged in April 1989 under the Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY).
 
• The JRY was meant to generate meaningful employment opportunities for the unemployed and underemployed in rural areas through the creation of economic infrastructure and community and social assets.

**Rural-Landless Employment Guarantee Programme ( RLEGP)**

 
• RLEGP was introduced on August 15, 1983.
 
• The objectives of the programme were:
 
 
• improving and expanding employment opportunities for the rural landless with a view to providing guarantee of employment to at least one member of every landless household up to 100 days in a year and
 
• creating durable assets for strengthening the infrastructure so as to meet the growing requirements of the rural economy.
